dedupe_keys.name: wp5 1 stochastic and empirical multi hazard event sets for europe earthquake stochastic event set for europe iso3166 code

description: The MYRIAD-EU and Risklayer team publishes a stochastic European earthquake event set intended to represent ten thousand years of simulated ground motions. Zenodo lists thirty-six country archives under CC BY 4.0. The page identifies an event catalogue and gridded peak-ground-acceleration and spectral components at 0.2, 0.5, 1.0 and 2.0 seconds. CSVs use longitude and latitude columns followed by event-specific intensity columns. These fields can drive probabilistic damage, disruption and cascading infrastructure simulations across European sectors. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this country-partitioned event set. Coverage is the modelled countries in the file inventory, not an observed ten-thousand-year earthquake history. A limitation is that spectral components below a stated 0.001 g maximum were filtered; users must check event alignment and units before aggregating losses across country files. No archive was downloaded, and neither ground-motion model nor return-frequency calibration was reproduced.
